facts.statement: The Ixalerpeton specimen was found in the Carnian-aged Santa Maria Formation of Brazil.
facts.quote: The specimen comes from the Carnian Santa Maria Formation of Brazil

facts.statement: The species name polesinensis refers to the town of São João do Polêsine, the location of the excavation site.
facts.quote: the species name polesinensis references the town of São João do Polêsine, where the dig site is located

facts.statement: The fourth trochanter of Ixalerpeton was quite large and formed a crest, a feature unlike that of Dromomeron.
facts.quote: in particular, its fourth trochanter was quite large and formed a crest (which is unlike Dromomeron)

facts.statement: Unlike Lagerpeton, the last few dorsal vertebrae of Ixalerpeton lack forward-inclining neural spines associated with a hopping lifestyle.
facts.quote: the last few dorsal vertebrae of Ixalerpeton do not have the forward-inclining neural spines of Lagerpeton (which were associated with the latter's hopping, or saltatory, lifestyle)

facts.statement: Ixalerpeton is distinguished by having an antitrochanter on the ilium, a tall ischium shaft end, and no ambiens process on the pubis.
facts.quote: there is an antitrochanter on the ilium; the end of the shaft of the ischium is tall; there is no ambiens process on the pubis

facts.statement: The medial condyle on the Ixalerpeton femur is relatively flat at the front but sharply angled at the back.
facts.quote: the medial condyle on the femur is relatively flat at the front end but sharply angled at the back end

facts.statement: An extra bone called the postfrontal borders the eye socket in Ixalerpeton.

facts.statement: Ixalerpeton lacks the supratemporal fossa, an indentation found on the frontal bone of dinosauriforms.
facts.quote: there is no supratemporal fossa, which is an indentation found on the frontal bone in dinosauriforms

facts.statement: The glenoid cavity on the Ixalerpeton scapula faces slightly sideways rather than backwards.
facts.quote: the glenoid cavity on the scapula, where the scapula-humerus joint is located, faces slightly sideways instead of backwards

facts.statement: Ixalerpeton is a genus of lagerpetid avemetatarsalian containing the single species I. polesinensis.
facts.quote: Ixalerpeton (meaning "leaping reptile") is a genus of lagerpetid avemetatarsalian containing one species, I. polesinensis

facts.statement: Ixalerpeton belongs to the family Lagerpetidae.
A 2016 phylogenetic analysis found that Ixalerpeton was the closest relative of Dromomeron.
facts.quote: Un análisis filogenético de 2016 encontró que Ixalerpeton era el pariente más cercano de Dromomeron

facts.statement: Ixalerpeton lived in the Late Triassic of Brazil alongside the sauropodomorph dinosaur Buriolestes.

facts.statement: Ixalerpeton lived during the Carnian stage, between 237 and 227.3 million years ago.
